service.description: The API's short name: run, compute, storage, sqladmin, container, pubsub, cloudbuild, artifactregistry, clouderrorreporting, cloudtrace, recommender, cloudscheduler, cloudtasks, cloudfunctions

version.description: API version such as v1, v2 or v1beta1. Default: the version Google prefers

method.description: The Discovery method without the API prefix, such as projects.locations.services.list

params.description: Path and query parameters, such as {"parent": "projects/acme-stage/locations/europe-west1", "pageSize": 50}. Pass data.nextPageToken back as pageToken

body.description: Request body of a read-only POST (getIamPolicy, testIamPermissions); GET methods take none
